repo_irregularities.issue: Property named "grains_per_troy_ounce": 31.1034768 mislabels grams per troy ounce (31.1034768 g/ozt) as grains per troy ounce (1 ozt = 480 grains per NIST Handbook 130 § 2.17).
repo_irregularities.resolution: Add canonical "grams_per_troy_ounce": 31.1034768 and "true_grains_per_troy_ounce": 480 while preserving backwards compatibility.
